page.layout: One column of text on a single manuscript leaf, with red and blue initials. Red rubric labels sit at the ends of several lines. No margin notes. Below the text the page is blank.

main_text.p: Dum [?] coelestia sup-plicationes [?] deprecamur ut quae famula seruitutis donantur [?] digna sensibus tuo munere capiamus. Q. Ffia vi.
Omnia quae omnipotens deus ut obseruationis sacrae annua [?] deuotione celebramus, corporis tibi placeamus [?] Q. sco Ofice Apphete.

page.notes: The leaf is a manuscript, not a printed page, with rubrics in red and a blue initial. The top line is cropped and largely illegible. Many words are faded or abraded and were read with low confidence, so most are marked [?]. The rubric labels at the right ends of lines (Oplin, Q. Ffia vi, Collecta, Q. sco Ofice Apphete) are only approximate readings. The bottom of the page is blank, so there is no catchword or signature.
